IF EXISTS(SELECT table_name FROM INFORMATION_SCHEMA.tables where table_name = 'CRM_CORPDBAINFO' and table_schema = 'EDS' and table_type = 'BASE TABLE')
BEGIN
   DROP TABLE EDS.CRM_CORPDBAINFO;
END;
IF EXISTS(SELECT table_name FROM INFORMATION_SCHEMA.tables where table_name = 'CRM_CORPDBAINFO' and table_schema = 'EDS' and table_type = 'VIEW')
BEGIN
   DROP VIEW EDS.CRM_CORPDBAINFO;
END;


CREATE TABLE EDS.CRM_CORPDBAINFO
WITH
(
	HEAP, DISTRIBUTION=HASH(CORPDBAINFOID)
)
AS
SELECT CORPDBAINFOID
	, BANK_ID
	, ENTITY_CREATE_FLG
	, CORP_ID
	, NAME
	, BODATECREATED
	, BODATEMODIFIED
	, BOCREATEDBY
	, BOMODIFIEDBY
	, CONCURDETECT_X
	, BOACLID
	, EXTENSIONID
	, SECURITYILHINT
	, SECURITYIUHINT
	, SECURITYGLHINT
	, SECURITYGUHINT
	, CORP_KEY
	, TMDATE
	, CAST(Left(Right(FILE_NAME, 12), 8) AS DATE) AS SCD_START_DATE
	, COALESCE(DATE_DIM.Previous_Business_Day, CAST('99991231' AS DATE)) AS SCD_END_DATE
	, ISACTIVE
	, CASE WHEN DATE_DIM.Previous_Business_Day is null then 1 else 0 end as ISLATEST
	, BNK_CODE
	, SOURCE_CODE
	, FILE_NAME
	, insert_dttm

FROM
(
	SELECT CORPDBAINFOID
		, BANK_ID
		, ENTITY_CREATE_FLG
		, CORP_ID
		, NAME
		, BODATECREATED
		, BODATEMODIFIED
		, BOCREATEDBY
		, BOMODIFIEDBY
		, CONCURDETECT_X
		, BOACLID
		, EXTENSIONID
		, SECURITYILHINT
		, SECURITYIUHINT
		, SECURITYGLHINT
		, SECURITYGUHINT
		, CORP_KEY
		, TMDATE
		, isActive
		, isLatest
		, BNK_CODE
		, SOURCE_CODE
		, FILE_NAME
		, insert_dttm

		, CAST(Left(Right(FILE_NAME, 12), 8) AS DATE) START_DATE     
		, Max(Left(Right(FILE_NAME, 12), 8)) Over (PARTITION BY CORPDBAINFOID, BANK_ID
			ORDER BY Left(Right(FILE_NAME, 12), 8) ROWS BETWEEN 1 Following AND 1 Following) END_DATE                  				
	FROM
	(
		SELECT CORPDBAINFOID
			, BANK_ID
			, ENTITY_CREATE_FLG
			, CORP_ID
			, NAME
			, BODATECREATED
			, BODATEMODIFIED
			, BOCREATEDBY
			, BOMODIFIEDBY
			, CONCURDETECT_X
			, BOACLID
			, EXTENSIONID
			, SECURITYILHINT
			, SECURITYIUHINT
			, SECURITYGLHINT
			, SECURITYGUHINT
			, CORP_KEY
			, TMDATE
			, isActive
			, isLatest
			, BNK_CODE
			, SOURCE_CODE
			, FILE_NAME
			, insert_dttm

			, row_number() 
				over( partition by CORPDBAINFOID
						, BANK_ID
						, ENTITY_CREATE_FLG
						, CORP_ID
						, NAME
						, BODATECREATED
						, BODATEMODIFIED
						, BOCREATEDBY
						, BOMODIFIEDBY
						, CONCURDETECT_X
						, BOACLID
						, EXTENSIONID
						, SECURITYILHINT
						, SECURITYIUHINT
						, SECURITYGLHINT
						, SECURITYGUHINT
						, CORP_KEY
						, TMDATE
						, isActive
						, isLatest
						, BNK_CODE
						, SOURCE_CODE
						, FILE_NAME
					order by insert_dttm DESC) AS SEQ_NO
		FROM BUSC.CRM_CORPDBAINFO

	) AS TMP
	WHERE SEQ_NO = 1
) AS SCDT2
LEFT JOIN EDS.DATE_DIM
	ON CAST(END_DATE AS INTEGER) = DATE_DIM.DATESK;

		, CARDTYPE
		, CARDSUBTYPE
		, CARDSTATUS
		, EXPIRYDATE
		, CUSTOMFIELD1
		, CUSTOMFIELD2
		, CUSTOMFIELD3
		, CUSTOMFIELD4
		, CUSTOMFIELD5
		, BANK_ID
		, CIFID
		, isActive
		, isLatest
		, BNK_CODE
		, SOURCE_CODE
		, FILE_NAME
		, insert_dttm

		, CAST(Left(Right(FILE_NAME, 12), 8) AS DATE) START_DATE     
		, Max(Left(Right(FILE_NAME, 12), 8)) Over (PARTITION BY CARDNUMBER, ACCOUNTID
			ORDER BY Left(Right(FILE_NAME, 12), 8) ROWS BETWEEN 1 Following AND 1 Following) END_DATE                  				
	FROM
	(
		SELECT CARDNUMBER
			, EMBOSSNAME
			, ACCOUNTID
			, CARDTYPE
			, CARDSUBTYPE
			, CARDSTATUS
			, EXPIRYDATE
			, CUSTOMFIELD1
			, CUSTOMFIELD2
			, CUSTOMFIELD3
			, CUSTOMFIELD4
			, CUSTOMFIELD5
			, BANK_ID
			, CIFID
			, isActive
			, isLatest
			, BNK_CODE
			, SOURCE_CODE
			, FILE_NAME
			, insert_dttm


			, row_number() 
				over( partition by CARDNUMBER
						, EMBOSSNAME
						, ACCOUNTID
						, CARDTYPE
						, CARDSUBTYPE
						, CARDSTATUS
						, EXPIRYDATE
						, CUSTOMFIELD1
						, CUSTOMFIELD2
						, CUSTOMFIELD3
						, CUSTOMFIELD4
						, CUSTOMFIELD5
						, BANK_ID
						, CIFID
						, isActive
						, isLatest
						, BNK_CODE
						, SOURCE_CODE
						, FILE_NAME

					order by insert_dttm DESC) AS SEQ_NO
		FROM BUSC.CRM_CBCCUSTCARDDETAILS

	) AS TMP
	WHERE SEQ_NO = 1
) AS SCDT2
LEFT JOIN EDS.DATE_DIM
	ON CAST(END_DATE AS INTEGER) = DATE_DIM.DATESK;
